name: Introduction and overview — An-225 Mriya — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — An-225 Mriya
description: Introduction and overview of the An-225 Mriya: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The An-225 Mriya was a six-engine strategic airlifter built by Antonov, the largest and heaviest aircraft ever flown. First flown in 1988 to carry the Soviet Buran space shuttle, the single completed airframe set 240 world records carrying outsized cargo. It was destroyed during the 2022 battle for Hostomel airport in Ukraine. Baseline facts: Six-engine super-heavy airlifter; one completed by Antonov in 1988; largest aircraft ever flown; destroyed 2022..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.

The An-225 Mriya was a six-engine strategic airlifter built by Antonov, the largest and heaviest aircraft ever flown.
